messages:
alex: quick idea 1: add tiny provenance probes + an audit-only alert for missing tokens before ledger finalization. want low-noise detection so billing can decide.

nina: makes sense. probe semantics? freq, fields, and storage?

alex: probe = lightweight heartbeat from ingest shard every 5m when shard has activity. payload: shard_id, tenant_sample_hash, last_event_ts, small fingerprint sample. keep it out of metric system except aggregated counts.

prateek: beware alert noise for dormant tenants. suggest two-stage gating: only evaluate tenants with >0 tokens in last 7d, and use percentile-based thresholds (per-traffic-quantile).

ops-bot: note: previous generic thresholds caused many false positives. recommend suppression window (24h) + escalation if severity increases.

billing-bot: please include `repair_suggested_by` and `repair_runbook_url` in the audit event. billing wants context + quick triage links.

alex: agreed. audit event prototype fields: type=provenance_alert, tenant_id, shard, last_seen_ts, fingerprints[], repair_suggested_by, repair_confidence, repair_runbook_url, repair_event_id (uuid). emit to audit bucket/warehouse for downstream tooling.

nina: metric cardinality: aggregate heartbeats by tenant_tier and geo; only expose per-tenant metrics for enterprise-flag tenants. raw proofs live in audit store.

prateek: add idempotency note: any repair action must include repair_event_id so billing can de-dupe. sign events with ingestion key to prevent tampering.

alex: dashboards: heartbeat.missing_rate (agg), provenance_alerts.by_tier, time_since_last_event.p50/p95. alert paging: page on severity=high or missing_rate > 0.2% sustained 10m.

nina: I'll add dashboard templates + suppression rules. prateek: can you write the schema PR for audit event?

prateek: yes. I'll draft schema + sample queries for warehouse triage (simple SQL to find tenants with last_seen < now()-interval '15 minutes').

ops-bot: action: RFC PR with probe proto, event schema, aggregation plan, sample queries, runbook template. tag @billing-team.

alex: i'll open RFC tonight and schedule a 30m follow-up once PR posted.

all: :thumbsup:
